    Profile

    Blair is a talented inventor and artificer from Slothstein. Her inventions, though ingenious are often eccentric and seldom recognized among her peers. Although she has an illustrious patron who often orders many different concealed gadgets, she still yearns to join in the camaraderie of the Inventors guild. Though she dresses like a boy, Blair loves cute and adorable things but is shy about it.

    Origin: Slothstein
    Gender: Female
    Height: 163cm
    Weight: 43kg
    Birthday: Sep 18
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Ice Water Wolf
    Likes: Gadgets, cute things
